text:
The prepositions in the text are:

1.  **on** (in "live on") - Connects the verb "live" to the object "the planet".
2.  **Among** (in "Among the crowd") - Connects the action of searching to the location/context "the crowd".
3.  **for** (in "searched for") - Connects the verb "searched" to its object "inspiration".
4.  **from** (in "from face") - Connects the verb "moving" to the starting point "face".
5.  **to** (in "to face") - Connects the verb "moving" to the endpoint "face".
6.  **for** (in "spark for") - Connects the noun "spark" to its purpose or recipient "her next creation".
7.  **in** (in "in the hustle") - Connects the location "here" to the specific context "the hustle and bustle of the city".
8.  **of** (in "bustle of") - Connects the noun "bustle" to its modifier "the city".
9.  **in** (in "in the city") - Connects the noun "bustle" to its location "the city".
